# Documentation browser assets

Scalar API Reference 1.76.0, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@scalar/api-reference@1.76.0/dist/browser/standalone.js (MIT; scalar-LICENSE.txt). The checked-in file is deterministic gzip; uncompressed SHA256: dcb027152bf20bf2f6dcd66e8f9fb073c1a9e274cf0b94b939a7d99ab8947060.

Ubuntu Sans and Ubuntu Sans Mono Latin WOFF2 fonts downloaded from Google Fonts; Ubuntu Font Licence texts are included.

Assets are served locally so documentation rendering does not require a CDN.
